video_title: Denver Nuggets Full Practice Media Availability | 10.9.26

quotes.speaker: Julian Strawther
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Strawther on the competitive nature of the Nuggets' training camp
quotes.excerpt: a majority of the guys in here are fighting for zones, so it's good for us
quotes.quote: It's definitely competitive. A majority of the guys in here are fighting for zones, so it's good for us as a group and it's good individually because everybody got to be pushing each other.
quotes.social_post: Julian Strawther on the Nuggets training camp intensity: It is definitely competitive. A majority of the guys in here are fighting for zones, so it is good for us as a group and it is good individually because everybody got to be pushing each other.

quotes.speaker: Julian Strawther
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Strawther on his improved confidence and comfort on the floor
quotes.excerpt: I feel more natural just on the floor. I feel comfortable out there
quotes.quote: I think right now just my confidence in my game on both ends of the floor and just I feel more natural just on the floor. I feel comfortable out there. I feel like I know where I'm effective, what things help the team, what things hurt the team, so just trying to hone in on those things and just be an efficient and effective player every night.
quotes.social_post: Julian Strawther says he feels more natural and comfortable on the floor this season: I feel like I know where I am effective, what things help the team, what things hurt the team, so just trying to hone in on those things.

quotes.speaker: Julian Strawther
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Strawther on simplifying his game to increase his effectiveness
quotes.excerpt: I could be a chaotic player, so just trying to be more simple
quotes.quote: Just being a smarter player. Obviously I'm known as I could be a chaotic player, so just trying to be more simple, just to try to boost my effectiveness out there.
quotes.social_post: Julian Strawther is looking to cut down on the chaos in his game: Obviously I am known as I could be a chaotic player, so just trying to be more simple, just to try to boost my effectiveness out there.

quotes.speaker: Julian Strawther
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Strawther on his development as a playmaker and scorer
quotes.excerpt: the coaches have seen me as a guy that can be a cog on offense
quotes.quote: I feel like you could say 60-65% of the time I've been in the NBA, I've either been in the stay-ready games or Summer League or G League or something where I've been the focal point of the offense. So that's what the coaches have seen me as a guy that can be a cog on offense and do different things, be a playmaker, be a scorer. So it's definitely allowed me to explore my game and I feel like it's for the better. I found a lot of things about my game that I'm better than people expected.
quotes.social_post: Julian Strawther on his development as a playmaker: I found a lot of things about my game that I am better than people expected.

quotes.speaker: Julian Strawther
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Strawther on the mentorship of teammate Tyus Jones
quotes.excerpt: having a true point guard in the gym with me all summer and finding me in spots
quotes.quote: Just being a guy that's been around the block, seen a lot of things in this league, been around for a while, and for him to be in the gym all summer with the young guys and just having a true point guard in the gym with me all summer and finding me in spots and understanding where he wants me on the floor. He's a true floor general, there's not too many left in the league, so just being able to play with one is super fun and me and Tyus are super close.
quotes.social_post: Julian Strawther on playing with Tyus Jones: He is a true floor general, there are not too many left in the league, so just being able to play with one is super fun.

quotes.speaker: Julian Strawther
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Strawther on adapting his role based on team lineups
quotes.excerpt: if I'm out there with the starters, I understand my job is to be a shooter
quotes.quote: Understanding who I'm on the floor with. Different lineups call for different things. If I'm out there with the starters, I understand my job is to be a shooter, space the floor, and bring energy to the game. If I'm out there with the bench, I understand that me and Demar look at as guys to score the ball and be those focal points on offense. So just understanding who I'm on the floor with and what the game's calling for.
quotes.social_post: Julian Strawther on his evolving role: If I am out there with the starters, I understand my job is to be a shooter. If I am out there with the bench, I understand that me and Demar look at as guys to score the ball.

quotes.speaker: Julian Strawther
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Strawther on replicating the production of Tim Hardaway Jr.
quotes.excerpt: finding ways to replicate Tim's production, the things that he was able to do for us
quotes.quote: That's all I've heard all summer is just finding ways to replicate Tim's production, the things that he was able to do for us. Obviously he had an amazing year, 6th man of the year finalist, so we're obviously missing that and we got to fill that void. But understanding that my skill set is the one that matches the most with his and my willingness to go out there and shoot. At the end of the day you need a guy that's a little bit unconscious, a little bit crazy in the head to go out there and launch threes as soon as they come off.
quotes.social_post: Julian Strawther on filling the void left by Tim Hardaway Jr: My skill set is the one that matches the most with his. You need a guy that is a little bit unconscious, a little bit crazy in the head to go out there and launch threes.

quotes.speaker: Alpha Diallo
quotes.summary_phrase: Alpha Diallo on his all-around game and team role
quotes.excerpt: I think as the season goes on, it's going to show just my all-around play
quotes.quote: I think as the season goes on, it's going to show just my all-around play. I think I can bring a lot of different things to the table and as the game goes on, whatever the coaches need me to do, I think that's where we're going to start with.
quotes.social_post: Alpha Diallo on his role with the Nuggets: I think I can bring a lot of different things to the table and as the game goes on, whatever the coaches need me to do, I think that is where we are going to start with.

quotes.speaker: Alpha Diallo
quotes.summary_phrase: Alpha Diallo on his defensive approach and consistency across leagues
quotes.excerpt: pressure the ball a lot and move my feet, try to stay between me and the basket
quotes.quote: I think for me it's always been the same, you know, just pressure the ball a lot and move my feet, try to stay between me and the basket and then contest shots. So whether that's in this league or a different league, I think it all translates.
quotes.social_post: Alpha Diallo on his defensive mindset: It has always been the same, just pressure the ball a lot and move my feet, try to stay between me and the basket and then contest shots.

quotes.speaker: Alpha Diallo
quotes.summary_phrase: Alpha Diallo on the importance of scouting and aggressive defense
quotes.excerpt: a lot of scouting maybe, scouting and then not caring what happens
quotes.quote: I think just a lot of scouting maybe, scouting and then not caring what happens, you know, just making sure that for you, you be aggressive, not try to foul, but still maintaining that aggressiveness.
quotes.social_post: Alpha Diallo on defensive aggression: Just making sure that for you, you be aggressive, not try to foul, but still maintaining that aggressiveness.

quotes.speaker: Alpha Diallo
quotes.summary_phrase: Alpha Diallo on his defensive instincts as second nature
quotes.excerpt: now that I've been doing it for so long, I think it's just second nature
quotes.quote: I think for me it's like a second nature thing. Now that I've been doing it for so long, I think it's just second nature like if a guy's maybe loose with the ball then maybe I'll go for it, but other than that I try to stay solid and you know, because a lot of times you reach and you don't get it then that's a foul on you, so I try to stay.
quotes.social_post: Alpha Diallo on his defensive instincts: It is like a second nature thing. Now that I have been doing it for so long, I think it is just second nature.

quotes.speaker: Alpha Diallo
quotes.summary_phrase: Alpha Diallo on the role of strength and conditioning in his defense
quotes.excerpt: it's a lot of weight room, a lot of strength and conditioning
quotes.quote: It's a lot of weight room, a lot of strength and conditioning. We got a great staff here and you know, they help keep my body ready and able to slide my feet, guard bigger guys, and guard smaller and faster guys as well. So it all translates from the weight room to the court.
quotes.social_post: Alpha Diallo credits the Nuggets staff for his defensive versatility: It is a lot of weight room, a lot of strength and conditioning. They help keep my body ready and able to slide my feet, guard bigger guys, and guard smaller and faster guys.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on Ryan Nemhard's impressive performance in practice
quotes.excerpt: the guy that stood out to me is Ryan Nemhard. Ryan Nemhard had a great day
quotes.quote: We mixed the groups today for the first time. So we got to see Demar with the first unit, we slid Aaron and CB to the second unit. The guy that stood out to me is Ryan Nemhard. Ryan Nemhard had a great day. Picking people up full, competing. He can run a team. He's been a good, not to say surprise, but he does some things I didn't realize he can do at his size. So he had a great day. It was super competitive. We actually the first scrimmage was a tie, the second one tie, they went to overtime. Jamal and Nicole's team won.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman highlights Ryan Nemhard after a strong practice: The guy that stood out to me is Ryan Nemhard. He had a great day. Picking people up full, competing. He can run a team. He does some things I did not realize he can do at his size.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on Ryan Nemhard's defensive screening and court presence
quotes.excerpt: screening. For his size, he just and he gets into people's legs
quotes.quote: Screening. For his size, he just and he gets into people's legs. They called a couple of illegal screens on him, which was good. That's a good thing, you know, if a guy's doing that in practice, he definitely can do it in a game. And just picking up full, I knew he could do it, but sometimes you got to tell somebody to do it, and he's just doing it.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on Ryan Nemhard: For his size, he gets into people's legs. They called a couple of illegal screens on him, which was good. That is a good thing, you know, if a guy is doing that in practice, he definitely can do it in a game.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on the need for improved transition defense
quotes.excerpt: transition defense, it's not just off misses, not all turnovers, it's after makes too
quotes.quote: Transition defense, it's not just off misses, not all turnovers, it's after makes too. We struggled last year. We'd score the basket and somebody else would score a basket on the other end. That has to be different this year.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman identifies a key area for improvement: Transition defense, it is not just off misses, not all turnovers, it is after makes too. We struggled last year. That has to be different this year.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on Julian Strawther's development as a screener
quotes.excerpt: Julian's getting there. Julian I think is learning. I think Tim helped him
quotes.quote: Julian's getting there. Julian I think is learning. I think Tim helped him, watching Tim last year play. It's why and when, you know, when you set it, when you slip, who has the ball, who the big is, you know, all that stuff is different, how they pitch the ball to you as opposed to a physical handoff. All the stuff that goes into screening also goes into what's going to happen after the screen.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on Julian Strawther's growth: Julian is learning. It is why and when, when you set it, when you slip, who has the ball, who the big is, all that stuff is different.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on Demar's role and the need for fundamental footwork
quotes.excerpt: Demar's going to we're going to get Demar the ball in spots
quotes.quote: For the first unit, they have to react to Demar too. Demar's going to we're going to get Demar the ball in spots. Today it was like a fundamental footwork session a few times. Our young guys have definitely never guarded a guy like Demar DeRozan. There was a lot of pump fake fly-bys, pump fake dive into you free throws, him taking his time.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on Demar DeRozan's impact in practice: Our young guys have definitely never guarded a guy like Demar DeRozan. There was a lot of pump fake fly-bys, pump fake dive into you free throws, him taking his time.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on the team's transition speed and defensive connectivity
quotes.excerpt: the speed of a Christian Brown setting a pick and roll in a center
quotes.quote: The speed of a Christian Brown setting a pick and roll in a center, these guys have never seen this and how do you show what angle, low man's got to be in, everybody's connected, exiting out behind it. You got Bryce and TV, this is new stuff. Alpha's new in the sense of in the NBA. So Alpha on the ball obviously is exceptional, but there's there's a whole another thing going on, you know, we're rotating behind Jokic.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on the team's defensive complexity: The speed of a Christian Brown setting a pick and roll in a center, these guys have never seen this. We are rotating behind Jokic.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on Alpha's need to adapt to playing the dunker spot
quotes.excerpt: I think he's got to get used to playing the dunker a little bit
quotes.quote: I think he's got to get used to playing the dunker a little bit. He made a couple corner threes, which is great, but if he's out there and it's Cam Johnson and blah blah blah, all of our main guys, he's going to have to play the dunker sometimes, especially if Aaron's not in the game. You guys saw this last year, we because of the injuries, Bruce had to do it, CB had to do it, Spencer Jones had to do it. It's good to see Spencer moving around.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on Alpha Diallo's role: I think he has got to get used to playing the dunker a little bit. He made a couple corner threes, which is great, but he is going to have to play the dunker sometimes.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on the team's approach to the remaining preseason games
quotes.excerpt: Chicago will play our guys again, then there'll be a discussion about LA
quotes.quote: I think Chicago will play our guys again, then there'll be a discussion about LA, which of the two games we won't play people. It's been interesting that I brought this up, we're playing our guys because they haven't played together. And they want to play because last year they didn't play. And so it's been interesting to watch Aaron, Jamal, Nicole, CB, Cam remember things that we ran last year that I stopped running because we didn't have the full group. That's been enjoyable to see, because guys are they forgot things that we put in.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on the preseason approach: We are playing our guys because they have not played together. It has been enjoyable to see, because guys are remembering things that we put in last year that I stopped running because we did not have the group.
